coverage_notes: [cable-satellite-tv] ROSTER BACKFILL 2026-09-30 (task roster-backfill-cable-satellite-tv, edited in place; change log in categories/roster-backfill-cable-satellite-tv.json). Totals now: 234 entries, 76 detailed, 158 roster, and 56 roster rows still without a website (151 before this pass). (1) Upgraded 40 roster operators to detailed. These are the largest remaining cable, municipal and co-op TV billers by approximate video footprint: Shentel cable, Glo Fiber, Comporium, Hotwire/Fision, Summit Broadband, ALLO, HBC, CDE Lightband, BTES, Cedar Falls Utilities, HTC, GVTC, Golden West, GTA, DOCOMO PACIFIC, Claro PR, ImOn, Conway Corp, Zito Media, Antietam, Swyft, Truvista, Frankfort Plant Board, Murray Electric, Glasgow EPB, Scottsboro EPB, GEUS, Wyandotte, Easton Utilities/Velocity, SELCO Shrewsbury, Lightcurve, CassComm, Hood Canal, TVS Cablenet/Thacker-Grigsby, Long Lines, Wadsworth CityLink, Boycom, Nelsonville TV, CNSNext Thomasville and Algona Municipal Utilities. Each detailed entry has pay, autopay and bill-history links taken from the official site this session (Zendesk/Salesforce sitemaps and APIs were used where pages are JavaScript-only), phones, payment processor, assistance programs, and a note on how to drop or downgrade the TV package. Duplicate rows in internet-rural-coops.json, internet-national-regional.json, landline-telcos.json and the electric/water files are cross-referenced in each note. (2) TV status corrections: Cedar Falls Utilities ends TV on 2026-10-11; Fayetteville Public Utilities (TN) ended cable TV on 2021-12-31; Riviera Utilities, Columbia Power & Water and Coldwater BPU no longer list a TV product; Adams CATV now redirects to Blue Ridge, Keene Valley Video to SLIC Fiber, Belzoni Cable to Southeast Broadband, WEHCO/Longview Cable to Cablelynx Broadband, and Inter-Mountain Cable to Gearheart; San Bruno CityNet's page is gone. Many operators have moved from QAM cable to app-based streaming TV (Shentel TV, SELCO Stream, CityLink View, NextStream, dTV+, Flight Video, Swyft TV). (3) Websites: about 95 previously empty or weak roster rows were given official sites. Method: exact-name cross-reference against every other category file and rosters/telecom_providers.csv, then about 3,900 name-derived candidate domains resolved by DNS, homepages fetched, and accepted only when the title or body matched the operator's distinctive name and the service area. Every accepted match was hand-reviewed and false positives were rejected (PR agencies, foreign ISPs, parked domains). Sites that answered only with bot challenges (Cloudflare 403, HTTP 202, Vercel 429) are recorded with verified=false. Checked against: rosters/telecom_cable_operators.csv (FCC Form 477 Jun-2021 cable holding companies + ACA Connects/NCTA flags) and the Leichtman/Wikipedia MSO table (previous pass). STILL MISSING: about 56 very small systems (mostly under 20,000 people covered) have no confirmable site, e.g. Cable TV of East Alabama, Country Cablevision, Access Cable, Bee Line Cable, Jefferson County Cable, Limestone Cable, Spring City Cable, Wire Tele-View, Somerfield, Belhaven, Ocracoke, Bridger, Tongue River and Iron River TV. Many probably bill by mail only or have closed. FCC COALS (Form 322) and the ACA Connects member directory both blocked our fetcher (403), and WebSearch quota was exhausted this pass. The next pass should use COALS community-unit contacts or web search for these names. Previous-pass notes still apply: the vMVPDs and the top-15 MVPDs were detailed in the first pass, and Cox is combining with Charter/Spectrum. Industry notes: Florida 55+/HOA communities (Hotwire, Summit, Blue Stream, Smartaira, Laguna Woods/West Coast Internet in CA) often bill TV through HOA dues, which a resident cannot drop individually. REVIEW PASS 2026-10-02 (skeptical second pass, task roster-backfill-cable-satellite-tv): Totals now 234 entries, 78 detailed, 156 roster, 56 roster rows still without a website. (a) Link check: every website/login/help/link URL on all detailed entries (448 unique URLs) was re-requested with curl; no hard 404s were found. Non-200 results were bot walls or JS apps (DIRECTV, Liberty PR, Fubo and Blue Stream 403; Summit and Blue Ridge Zendesk 403, which the Zendesk API can read; Optimum and Spectrum timeouts), not dead pages. Page titles of the 200 responses were scanned for soft-404s, and none were found. (b) Content re-read and fixes on these entries: Breezeline (help center moved to help.breezeline.com; all links updated; autopay_cancel and statements filled; payment-arrangement assistance link), Mediacom (autopay terms and statements login filled; /support pages 404), Armstrong (statements login and caregiver account-roles article), Service Electric Cablevision (customer service phone, PO Box mail address, statements), Sparklight (Payment History article; change/cancel-service article for dropping TV), Frontier (pay-by-phone 800-917-7489, mail address, customer service phone, affordability programs; contact page now says Frontier has joined Verizon), altafiber (phone and Fioptics Internet Assistance/Lifeline), WOW (pay-by-phone 1-866-496-9669), Ritter (autopay_cancel, Lifeline, phone), Shentel cable and Glo Fiber (autopay_setup and statements article URLs from the official support sitemap; Glo Fiber website corrected to glofiber.com), GTA (pay-by-phone and eBill login), Vyve (Essentials Connect low-income plan), TG/TVS (support page confirms billing is portal or phone only). (c) Completeness: rosters/telecom_cable_operators.csv (cable and fiber provider types) was compared with this file. Two TV billers that were missing were added as detailed: Muscatine Power and Water TV/MachLink (IA, still sells TV) and The Community Agency (TCA, O'Brien County IA, city-owned streaming video). Other unmatched roster rows are fixed-wireless or internet-only ISPs (Bluespan, Wired or Wireless, WindSpeed, KwiKom, PogoZone), or telco co-ops whose IPTV billing is already in internet-rural-coops.json and landline-telcos.json (Polar, Blue Valley, Rainbow, Panora/Guthrie, Star Telephone). These were not duplicated here. (d) Removed: Adams CATV (merged into Blue Ridge; note added to the Blue Ridge entry) and Fayetteville Public Utilities TN (FPU ended cable TV after 2021-12-31; its utility and internet billing stays in internet-rural-coops.json). Known remaining gaps: Hotwire/Fision, DOCOMO PACIFIC, Zito Media, Vyve, Hood Canal, Nelsonville and Wadsworth CityLink publish no public autopay or bill-history how-to pages; their help centers are JS-only or portal-only, so those link fields stay null. Riviera Utilities, Columbia Power & Water and Coldwater BPU are kept as roster rows, but no TV product was found on their sites. Users there should confirm on their bills.
